content:
Leo: Quick idea 30 Friday micro-test: compare Steam Deck native vs Steam Link on phone vs Parsec on same network for local party games. Want to settle whether phones are actually usable for run-and-gun co-op. @here :controller:
Priya: Love it. I can bring a cheap 8BitDo and a DualShock 4.
Marco: Ill bring my Pixel 7 and a USB-C ethernet adapter. Can we try wired vs wifi? Curious about jitter.
Ivy: Ill run a quick network check beforehand. If anyone knows how to reproduce bad conditions, bring a phone hotspot to simulate packet loss.
Leo: Plan: 7pm, mezz lounge. Host machine will run Steam + Parsec host. We'll try three setups: Deck native, Steam Link (phone), Parsec (phone). Short test games: Cuphead (tight inputs), Heave Ho (physics), Overcooked.
Priya: Poll: which metric should we log? Raw latency (ms), frame drops, or subjective "feel" score? Reply with 1/2/3.
Marco: 1 and 3. Raw numbers + feel.
Ivy: 2 for Overcooked only (frame hiccups matter more there).
Leo: OK majority = 1+3. I'll toss a simple spreadsheet with columns: setup, avg ping, median frame latency, subjective 1-5.
ops-bot: Event created: "Portable bridge test" Fri 19:00 3 mezzanine. RSVP: https://calendar.company/e/portable-bridge-test
Priya: Also: if anyone wants to bench wireless, try 5 GHz vs 2.4 GHz and note distance.
Marco: Noted. Ill bring an Ikea folding table and some ethernet. See you Friday :thumbsup:
